text:
joel: FYI — kickoff for quota escalation on the new org (org-id: redwood-acme-2026). Customer wants ~40 A100s across us-west-2 + europe-west1, and we ran into EIP + ENI limits in us-west-2. Need an action plan.

maya: Can you call out exact current vs requested quotas? Also any regional constraints (AZ vs region) we should care about? :eyes:

joel: Quick snapshot: AWS (us-west-2): EC2 accelerators (A100) current 8 -> request 60; Elastic IPs current 5 -> request 50; ENIs per region default 1000 -> request 5000. GCP (europe-west1): accelerator (a100) per project 0 -> request 40; CPUs vCPUs default 24k -> fine. Azure (westeurope): NCas cores current 200 -> request 1000.

samir: Filed AWS support case: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case/1234567891 — marked business-critical. Case summary attached.

joel: Adding the support request template I used for AWS/GCP/Azure — copy/paste for each cloud: 
```
Subject: Quota increase request for new customer org redwood-acme-2026 (production inference)
Account ID / Project: <AWS_ACCOUNT_ID or GCP_PROJECT_ID or SUBSCRIPTION_ID>
Requested resources: A100 GPUs (accelerator), Elastic IPs, ENIs, NAT/route table limits
Current: <numbers>
Requested: <numbers>
Reason: Production inference workload for enterprise customer; target sustained throughput X TPS and peak Y TPS; latency SLO 150ms. Will use Dedicated capacity (reserved) + autoscaling.
Urgency: 72h escalate if possible. Contact: joel@redwood.com, +1-555-0112
```

nora: For AWS EIP limits — note that default is 5 per region for classic EIPs; for large fleets we recommend using NAT gateways + private subnets and EIP pool only for load balancers. If they truly need many public IPs, we should escalate but include architecture note.

chris: We should also check subnet IP exhaustion — large node pools in small CIDRs will exhaust ENI/ipv4 addresses before quotas. Recommend /20 per AZ or use VPC IPv4 ranges with secondary CIDRs.

maya: Good point. Also include request for VPC peering limits and NAT gateway attachments. Send infra reviewers a list of all subnets and planned node counts per AZ.

joel: I'll attach planned capacity per cluster: 5 clusters x 8 nodes x 1 A100 each initially, then scale to 40 nodes total across clusters. Planning both spot + reserved pools.

samir: For GCP accelerator quotas you need to request at the project level and include accelerators in quota form — link: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=<PROJECT_ID> — I started a ticket: GCP-98765.

infra-bot: Reminder: open support cases should include billing owner and linked PO if pushing to enterprise queue.

joel: Also: encryption/KMS requirements. Customer requires CMKs in their account. For Private deployments we need cross-account KMS grants. Include KMS key ARN and IAM grant steps in the ticket.

nora: Action: I'll draft the AWS support body for EIP/ENI/accelerator quota increase and include justification for reserved capacity. Assign to samir for filing. ETA 3h.

maya: I'll prepare the subnet sizing doc and a quick calc sheet for IP consumption per node + ENI. Will include recommended /20 ranges. ETA 4h.

chris: I'll check AZ capacity reports for us-west-2 and europe-west1 for A100 availability. If capacity is constrained, we'll propose fallback regions and the smart-routing policy that falls back to Europe.

joel: Cost note: we should present an expected monthly spend delta for reserved vs on-demand GPUs. Customer prefers committed for predictability; propose 12-month reserved vs spot mix. I'll draft numbers.

samir: Filed AWS case 1234567891 with full body, attached architecture diagram and PO. Asking for 72h turnaround.

joel: Planning a short playcall in 45 minutes to align owners and hit submit together. Meeting invite: #infra-playcall 16:00 UTC. Please join if you own a deliverable. :rocket:

maya: Will join. I'll bring the subnet calc and chart.

nora: I'll join and walk through the support payloads.

chris: If anyone hits a hard quota rejection we should escalate via account manager / TAM. Add their contact info to the ticket.

joel: Post-playcall deliverables: (1) Submit AWS/GCP/Azure quota tickets (owner: samir) (2) Patch infra-as-code with updated CIDRs (owner: maya) (3) KMS cross-account grants doc (owner: nora) (4) Fallback region routing policy & rollout note (owner: chris) (5) Cost delta summary for customer (owner: joel).

infra-bot: Action items recorded: 5 tasks assigned.

joel: Thanks all — will paste final ticket bodies in this thread after the call so we have audit trail. :thumbsup:
